goals: Load test the e-commerce shopping workflow including browsing the shop, adding items to the cart, and completing the checkout process
Simulate user behavior to verify the performance and reliability of WooCommerce endpoints under load
activities: Generate a random product ID and quantity
Send a POST request to '/?wc-ajax=add_to_cart' with the generated product data and headers
Execute the addToCart method to add an item to the cart
Send a GET request to '/checkout/' using cookies from the add to cart response
Extract the checkout nonce from the checkout page response using a regular expression
Send a POST request to '/?wc-ajax=checkout' with personal billing and shipping data, the extracted nonce, and cookies
